experience.raw_text: Currently working as Project Scientist II under the sponsored Project Centre for Policy Research – Dept.

of Science and Technology (CPR-DST) New Delhi funded project at Central University of Gujarat, Gandhinagar. 08/12 – 06/14 Teaching Assistant, Dept. of Chemistry, Shiv Nadar University 09/23 – till now Project Scientist II under the sponsored Project Centre for Policy Research – Dept. of Science and Technology (CPR-DST) New Delhi funded project at Central University of Gujarat, Gandhinagar. 05/17-10/18 Research Scientist, Polymer R&D, Reliance Industries Ltd.; Elastomer division involving synthesis and modification of PBR and HIIR with requisite characterization and analysis techniques. 10/16 – 03/17 Research Associate, Dept. of Chemistry, Shiv Nadar University; Biobased Polybenzoxazine synthesis, characterization and applications. 05/08 – 07/08 Summer Training at School of Life Sciences, Jawahar Lal Nehru University,

skills:  Synthetic organic chemist with experience in complete characterization of large and small organic compounds by NMR, IR, UV-visible spectroscopy, LC-MS, GPC, HPLC, TGA, DSC, Rheology techniques.  Carried out the supervision of undergraduate project students and tutoring of chemistry students with practical demonstrations performed for both graduate and undergraduate students. Gained experience by working in collaboration with research groups in varied fields and locations  Possess good presentation and communication skills along with being an experienced user of MS Word, Powerpoint, Excel, Origin, NMR softwares (Topspin, Mestrec) and chemical data search system such as Scifinder.
